## 5. Scope and decisions

The founder has authorized one PR with 200 demos. No merge, deployment, verification exemption, new role or new dependency is requested. Principal-engineer classifies the new shared engines tier 2 and requires independent review before shipping. Three demo-builder runs maximum; builders use isolated worktrees.

## 6. Objections and answers

The batch can become a repeated quiz template. Answer: use distinct computed models and at least five visual/interaction families in each domain; review artifacts and every new route. A toy model can be mistaken for an empirical result. Answer: label toy models and retain unverified source claims separately.
